title: Voice Volume
desc: Change the volume of your copilot voice. NOTE: Applies to all voice types (Windows, Amazon, Google)

title: External TTS options : EDCoPilot can hand off ship AI voice generation and play to an external process. External process can listen to shipai_log.json for speech instructions.
Use an external TTS option for ship AI voice
desc: If this is ON will generate speech phrases but not speak them. Will add them to the shipai_log.json file for external processing

title: WinTTS Voice : NOTE: Edge is your default voice provider, but WinTTS will be used if all Cloud voice provider options are turned off (Edge, Amazon, Google, Azure, ElevenLabs)
Use WinTTS as default ship voice
desc: If this is ON and you have all Cloud voice provider options OFF, then will use WinTTS voice as default on startup. If this is OFF, will default to using Edge voices (which are better quality)

title: Windows TTS Voice
desc: Change the voice used by your copilot

title: Windows TTS Speech Rate
desc: Change the speed of your Windows TTS copilot voice (words per minute)

title: Bluetooth anti-clipping on/off
desc: Set this ON if you are using bluetooth headset or speakers and the first portion of the voice is being clipped. Starts a low background hum before the voice announcement, which wakes up any sleeping bluetooth channel

title: Voice start delay
desc: Time in seconds that EDCoPilot will pause from starting the background hum to triggering the voice announcement. Default is 0.2 seconds

title: Radio effect
desc: Your selected Cloud voice sounds as if its coming through your headset. Always=always on, None=always off, NotInShip=only applied when you leave your ship

title: Radio effect start and end beep
desc: If ON, your radio voice will start and end with a beep sound.

title: Radio volume gain (dB)
desc: Adjusts the volume level when the radio effect is applied (-50 to 50)

title: Radio white noise level
desc: The level of white noise heard when radio effect is applied (0-20)

title: Radio pop and click frequency
desc: The amount of pops and clicks heard when radio effect is applied (0-50)

title: Radio distortion level
desc: The amount of voice distortion when radio effect is applied (0-50)

title: Radio High Pass Filter
desc: Set this in the range 1200-2500. A higher value will sound more tinny and distant

title: Synthetic Ship Voice effect
desc: Adds a synthetic effect to your selected Cloud voice.

title: Synthetic voice volume gain (dB)
desc: Adjusts the volume level when the synthetic voice effect is applied (-50 to 50)

title: Use Alternate Interruptible player to play voice files
desc: Try setting this ON if the default player is giving you audio issues (clipping or stuttering).

title: Use Audioplayer to play voice files
desc: Only set this ON if the default player and alternate interruptible playing are both giving you issues. Note when this is set the *skip current phrase* feature will not work, nor will other voice cutoffs.

title: Apply Chorus Effect
desc: Toggle the chorus effect on or off

title: Chorus Rate (Hz)
desc: The speed of the chorus effect low-frequency oscillator (LFO), in Hertz. This value must be between 0 Hz and 100 Hz.

title: Chorus Depth
desc: The chorus depth (0 to 100)

title: Chorus Delay
desc: The chorus delay (0 to 30)

title: Chorus Feedback
desc: The chorus feedback (0 to 200)

title: Chorus Mix
desc: The chorus mix (0 to 100)

title: Chorus Pitchshift
desc: Adjust the pitch of the voice (-10 to 10)

title: Apply Reverb
desc: Toggle the reverb effect on or off
